growth_signal.value: Says it has grown sixfold since its 2023 Series A and now serves over 5,000 clients in 41 countries

entry.idea: Small hotels, B&Bs, and vacation rentals struggle to price rooms right and answer guest questions fast, so Smartness gives them AI tools for pricing, guest chat, and day-to-day booking management.
entry.lesson: Bundle several small, painful jobs (pricing, guest chat, booking software, marketing) into one product for an industry of small operators who cannot afford enterprise software.
entry.name: Smartness

growth.basis: number: grown sixfold since its 2023 Series A
growth.reason: It says its business has grown sixfold in a few years and just closed a big new funding round to expand further.

market.reason: Independent hotels and vacation rentals that need pricing and booking help exist in almost every country.

tech.reason: Its AI pricing and chatbot tools are solid engineering, but similar hotel revenue-management tools exist elsewhere, so a strong team could match them in a year or two.

entry.twist: One of its products lets hoteliers pay based on the extra revenue and bookings it actually brings in, instead of a flat monthly fee.
entry.who_pays: Hotel, B&B, and vacation rental owners who subscribe to Smartness's pricing, chatbot, website, and management products.
entry.why_now: Independent properties are squeezed by high commissions from booking sites and cannot afford the pricing technology that big hotel chains already use, so cheaper AI tools are in demand.
